title: Preface
summary: A 1972 FBI-style document (OCR-garbled) about former Beatle John Lennon's alleged financial support for the EYSIC (Election Year Information/Strategy Information Center) and the 'Allamuchy Tribe' led by Rennie Davis, a Chicago Seven defendant. Further content includes requests for information to INS and CIA, classification markings, and routing between Bureau offices.

nodes.title: BACKGROUND:

nodes.title: Stewart Albert
nodes.summary: A declassified-style FBI/intelligence document excerpt: a second source reported that Stewart Albert was arrested April 12, 1966, in Berkeley, California, while demonstrating with other Progressive Labor Party (PLP) members in front of Berkeley City Hall. The text also notes the MDC in New York City is publicly known as participating in demonstrations in Washington, D.C., in May 1971, sponsored by the PCPJ. summary: An FBI-style report on a February 6, 1972 meeting at the Irish Institute (NYC) of a committee against internment in Northern Ireland. summary: OCR'd 1972 newspaper and FBI file page. A May 13, 1972 benefit concert for the Attica Defense Committee drew a larger crowd than expected after John Lennon appeared on the Dick Cavett Show; attendees included Otto Preminger's party, security was tight, and the event ended after a bomb threat, raising about $2,000 for the defense committee.
